statusDefinitions.UNKNOWN: Evidence is absent, unlocated or contradictory; do not infer.
statusDefinitions.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a later task, decision or artifact (cited).
statusDefinitions.CLOSED: Closed by a Founder scope decision, not by implementation acceptance.
